spanish: Y dijeron a Moisés, diciendo: El pueblo multiplica a traer, más que bastancia del servicio para la obra que mandó Jehová a hacerla.
grammarChanges: Reordered 'Multiplica el pueblo' to 'El pueblo multiplica' so the clause reads as a 3rd-person indicative describing what the people do, removing the opening-word tú-imperative misreading flagged by the audit.
readerNote: Chose singular Spanish verb agreement for the collective 'el pueblo' against the Hebrew's plural Hiphil participle, and put subject before verb so 'multiplica' cannot be read as a command.
